content.short: POTLOCK is an open-source public-goods funding protocol running cross-chain donation rounds.
content.description: POTLOCK provides the infrastructure for public-goods funding rounds, including quadratic funding style pots, across several chains. Public-goods funding is a persistently unsolved problem in open source, and the on-chain attempts at it are at least measurable in a way grant committees are not.
content.meta: Infrastructure for public-goods funding rounds, with allocation measurable rather than opaque.
